summary: Make the before-action reaction window a true multi-reaction alternating window (Mendon's ruling on the Akodo Kakihara known limit, follow-up to #305/PR #308); merged with origin/main (Kahoku #316, pile targets #319, hand-played Attack discard #325). Shared lane: the rules change in src/L5R.Core is the substance; the routing also sees one AI regression test and the legal-action listing (MatchQueries). Every applicable reaction (Rokai, Tamoko, Champion of Thunder, Brothers of Goemon, Kakihara, any future watcher) of BOTH players is takeable: the turn player has the first opportunity when they hold a reaction, then the other player, alternating via the existing PassReaction/NextAction machinery until both pass consecutively, then the deferred command resolves. BeforeActionReactionApplies is the single live eligibility source (window opening, QueryActions, ValidateAbility). FirstReactionOpportunity/OpenAlternatingReactionWindow are generic for the Engage window (#310). MatchState.NegatedEffects (a composable list) replaces the single negation pair. Kakihara's bonus is added directly so a Champion cannot cancel it. The Attack window (previously attacked-side-first) follows the same first-opportunity rule. New since the merge: Kahoku - exp is Attack-classified but its TargetId is a separate -4F target, so the before-action window's Attack exclusion is now TargetsThroughAttackPipeline (Attack-classified and Target attack), with a regression test.
validation: After merging origin/main: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests 216/216 core, 57/57 published; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (python 43+130, gold-parity 18, gold-quote 20, L5R.AI.Tests 15, L5R.Server.Tests 6, L5R.Client.Transport.Tests 5). Client: dotnet build src/L5R.Client succeeded (0 warnings), Godot 4.7.2 headless import and smoke both exit 0 with 0 ERROR lines (using the main checkout's .tools/godot). 19 targeted logic mutations: all killed except one equivalent (single-purpose negation never consumed). No wave file or card change: pinned count 396 equals origin/main (re-derived by counting content/published).
remaining: Documented, not silent: targeting means command.TargetId only; Unimpeachable Name (a hand card) is still its own separate window, not folded into this one.
